text: {"lessons":["Taking profits on Stock E, B, and D felt satisfying, but a gain alone is not a reason to sell; I should consider each holding on its merits.","Avoid letting the pain of selling at a loss keep me from making a sound decision; average cost is not a forecast of future prices.","Recent price changes do not predict what comes next, so I should avoid frequent trading based on short-term moves and make deliberate decisions within my cash and holdings."]}
